messages:
Rae Morgan: quick heads-up from a manual pass  noticed pill-style primary buttons on the Dataset table toolbar are visually compressing at 340px. Icon + pill label looks smushed. attached screenshot.
Priya Patel: hmm, we converted buttons to pill tokens last quarter (spacing.flush) but maybe pills need a slightly larger inline gap for labels. product prefers keeping pill affordance for compact rows though.
Gabe Ortiz: dev note: avoid touching spacing.flush globally. propose new tokens: component.button.pill-gap = 10px and component.button.pill-pad-x = 14px. keeps vertical pad 6px so hit area >= 44px.
Lin Wei: also repro: the modal on Table > Row actions has a 1px bleed where toast enters from bottom when an import completes. Looks like toast stacking + modal corner radius created a visual overlap.
Rae Morgan: maybe the toast should respect a safe-area inset when a modal is open. Could be a simple z-index + bottom offset rule.
Gabe Ortiz: here's a quick CSS sketch I'll prototype:
```css
:root { --btn-pill-gap: 10px; --btn-pill-pad-x: 14px; --layer-toast: var(--layer-map-toast, 1200); --layer-modal: var(--layer-map-modal, 1300); }
.button--pill { padding: 6px var(--btn-pill-pad-x); gap: var(--btn-pill-gap); min-height: 44px; }
.toast { z-index: var(--layer-toast); right: 16px; bottom: 16px; }
.modal--open .toast { bottom: calc(16px + var(--modal-offset, 56px)); }
```
Priya Patel: copy: product wants toast CTA copy short and consistent: "Undo", "View", "Retry". Also avoid showing raw token names in tooltips or QA notes.
accessibility-bot: checklist: ensure pill-button glyphs have aria-hidden when decorative, icon+label combos maintain 44px hit target, :focus-visible contrasts meet token focus.contrast, and toasts use aria-live for announcements. Also confirm screen reader behavior when modal is open + toast fires.
design-lint-bot: visual lint: pill corner radius increased by 2px in dark theme causing perceived shift. Include light/dark screenshots in PR.
Lin Wei: i18n: some locales lengthen labels and pills break on narrow screens. We should fallback to icon-only with accessible aria-labels in those locales. Add a responsive rule: @media (max-width:360px) show icon-only if label width > 120px.
Gabe Ortiz: will add runtime test for localized labels and implement aria-label fallback. Branch: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/656 (prototype).
Rae Morgan: scheduling a quick 15-min sync after standup to finalize token names, toast stacking rules when modals are open, and the i18n fallback. /remind me in 15
accessibility-bot: Reminder set for Rae Morgan in 15 minutes."
